title: The eight curve assertions pass to finite direct images
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure], let $X$ and $Y$ be separated schemes of finite type over $k$ of dimension at most one, and let $f:X\to Y$ be a finite morphism of $k$-schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $F$ be a torsion abelian sheaf on $X_{\Et}$, so that $(X,F)$ is a curve coefficient pair [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting]. Then the direct image $f_*F$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] is a torsion abelian sheaf on $Y_{\Et}$, and if the eight assertions $\mathcal C(X,F)$ of [def-weil-pbc-eight-curve-assertions] hold, then $\mathcal C(Y,f_*F)$ hold.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Section 03SB, Lemma 0A5D (lemma-finite-pushforward-statements); its proof uses Proposition 03QP (vanishing of R^qf_* for finite f), the Leray spectral sequence (Cohomology on Sites, Lemma 0733 sites-cohomology-lemma-apply-Leray) and Lemma 0959 (finite pushforward commutes with base change)
